10446442561853.name: iSANMATE PLA Transparent Filament 1.75 mm, Clear 3D Printer Filament, Suitable for High-Speed Printing, 1 KG*10 Spools
10446442561853.description_html:
iSANMATE PLA Transparent Filament 1.75 mm, Clear 3D Printer Filament, Suitable for High-Speed Printing, 1 KG*10 Spools

【High-Purity PLA Filament】iSANMATE Transparent PLA filament 1.75mm is made from renewable plant-based raw materials, giving it higher strength and toughness without warping. iSANMATE 3D printer filament is compatible with most FDM 3D printers on the market (the depth and brightness of the filament color depend on the model chosen for printing)
【Tips & Recommended Settings】💡Tip: ①If needed, dry the material at 50°C for 5–8 hours before printing; ②Adjust the wall thickness to control light transmission; ③Adjust the model size to control the color change. Recommended nozzle temperature: 190-220 °C; Bed temperature: 35-60 °C; Print speed: 30–300 mm/s
【Strong Layer Adhesion & Stable Printing】Made from high-quality PLA material, our 3D printer filament offers excellent layer adhesion, low shrinkage and strong adhesion to the print bed
【Precise Diameter & Tangle-Free Spool】The 1.75 mm PLA filament is manufactured to a strict diameter tolerance of 1.75 mm ±0.02 mm and extrudes smoothly, ensuring consistent flow and reliable print quality. Each spool is neatly wound and vacuum-sealed with a desiccant to reduce moisture absorption and prevent tangling
【Technical Solutions】We provide fast and efficient technical solutions for any printing problem – with a guaranteed response within 24 hours.
